name: Web Agent Comparison
description: Reproducible 8-dimension benchmark of 7 browser-automation MCP servers (Playwright, Lightpanda, browser-use, Chrome DevTools, Firecrawl, Cloakbrowser, Obscura) against frozen loopback fixtures. v1.0.2 adds cross-platform evidence + real Chrome TLS fingerprint baseline. v1.1 expands fixtures to general web tasks.
